task.description:
Validate the test design produced by TEST-DESIGNER (Step 03) for requirements PD-UI-01 through PD-UI-04. This is a HARD GATE — FAIL immediately if any check fails.

Verify:
1. Every MUST requirement has a runnable integration test file
2. No test.skip on MUST tests without a counterpart integration test
3. All fixtures use per-test UUIDs
4. Tests clean up after themselves
5. Tests fail clearly if backend is unavailable
6. No MSW, no HTTP mocking (T-2 directive)
7. Visual verification included (T-3 directive)
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement (PD-UI-01 through PD-UI-04) has a Playwright E2E test
No test.skip decorators on MUST requirement tests
No MSW or HTTP mocking present

result.summary: Test design validation PASSED for PD-UI-01 through PD-UI-04. All 7 verification checks passed.

issues.description: Test spec defines TC-PDUI02-03 (multi-select) and TC-PDUI03-02 (multiple versions), TC-PDUI03-03 (Open link), TC-PDUI03-05 (loading state), TC-PDUI01-04 (pagination) which are not yet implemented in the test file. Each MUST requirement still has at least one covering test — no blocking issue.
